description: This file defines the internal class GeneratedEventReporterGrain, which implements the IGeneratedEventReporterGrain interface. It manages stream reporting data, including recording report results, retrieving reports, resetting data, and checking silo location within an Orleans distributed system.

classes.name: GeneratedEventReporterGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain that reports and retrieves stream processing results, with methods to reset its internal state and verify its silo location.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Initializes the reports dictionary when the grain is activated.

methods.name: ReportResult
methods.description: Records the count result for a specific stream identified by its provider, namespace, and GUID.

methods.name: GetReport
methods.description: Retrieves the report data for a given stream provider and namespace.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the internal reports dictionary to an empty state.

methods.name: IsLocatedOnSilo
methods.description: Checks if the grain is located on the specified silo address.
